summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by modifying the `none()` method to handle combined queries correctly. The patch includes a new script to reproduce the issue and verify the fix.

issues.description: The patch introduces new files (`reproduce.py`, `test_app/__init__.py`, `test_app/migrations/0001_initial.py`, `test_app/migrations/__init__.py`) which are not part of the standard Django application structure. This may cause confusion for users familiar with the typical Django project layout.
